newsitem.title: USA: PEPCO sees 672 MW Md. oil unit back Tues..
newsitem.headline: PEPCO sees 672 MW Md. oil unit back Tues..

text.p: Potomac Electric Power Co (PEPCO) said Tuesday its 672 megawatt (MW) Chalk Point 3 generating unit was scheduled to be ready for service later today after being shut last weekend for repairs.
The oil-fired unit in Aquasco, Md., was taken off line because of a condenser water box leak.
The facility's 341 MW coal-fired unit 1 was expected to resume operation Thursday, a company spokeswoman said.
The Chalk Point 1 unit also was shut last weekend to correct a boiler tube leak.
Despite the outages of both Chalk Point units, the utility has ample capacity to meet power demand on its system, the spokeswoman said.
PEPCO is the operator and sole owner of the Chalk Point facility, whose four units have a combined installed capacity just above 2,000 MW.
